title: Above which average?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the distinction between a mean and a median.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the distinction between a mean and a median affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Above, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the distinction between a mean and a median in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy group has 99 people scoring 10 each and one scoring 0. How many are strictly above the group mean?
